digest.component_or_area: Git repository history rewrite operational script
propositions: A committed operational script must rewrite the tickets branch history using stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) to strip .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes from all historical revisions.

The dry-run implementation must execute in a fresh unfiltered clone (rejecting partial/blob:none clones), preserve DAG topology and merge commits, dynamically re-add current .bridge_state files from git ls-tree, and measure the final pack at or under 150 MB.

All acceptance criteria must pass before the script emits success: commit/merge counts unchanged, tree byte-identical after re-add, target history absent except at rewritten HEAD, remote refs unchanged, protected tag absent locally, and no remote push operations.
The script must parse fast-export data blocks by byte length (not line-based grep) to correctly filter commit messages that begin with M or D command prefixes.
A representative review-bot event push after rewrite must succeed with less than 1 MB incremental pack growth and must prove old-tip is not an ancestor of new-tip.
